name: resistance_to_a_lone_objection
description: Two beliefs facing the identical objection, differing only in how well grounded they are: one holds a single evidence record, the other five. Under a fixed penalty both are pushed by the same amount, because the constant cannot see the difference. Under provenance pricing the well-corroborated belief barely moves. This is the property that justifies removing the constant, and it is the case a fixed penalty cannot represent at any value.
evidence_count_note: The two targets differ ONLY in evidence_count. Both objections are identical in confidence and evidence, so any difference in outcome is the targets' grounding.
